card.name: Semicolons in course topic lists
card.fires_on: Mostly semicolons separating items in a list of history course topics (Latin American colonial history, conquest, revolutions). It also fires weakly on small words like 'the', 'of' and 'a' in the same kind of academic history description.

modes.label: Semicolons in topic list
modes.description: Semicolon between items in a list of historical topics in a course description.
modes.example: colonial socio-political structures; labor systems; revolutions; neocolonialism<<;>> and the role of the military in Latin

modes.label: Small words in history prose
modes.description: Words like 'the', 'a' or 'of' within descriptions of historical or political struggle and change.
modes.example: Topics include<< the>> nature of encounters between indigenous populations, Europeans

card.plain: It lights up on the semicolons that separate items in a list of history topics, such as a university course description on Latin American history.
